title: SB5444 (2017-2018 Regular): Concerning enhanced background checks and licensure for assault weapons and large capacity magazines.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States public data converted to LegiScan layout (gun-policy Stage 5, Washington); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Washington Legislature text (Comm Sub, https://lawfilesext.leg.wa.gov/Biennium/2017-18/Htm/Bills/Senate%20Bills/5444-S.htm, downloaded directly)
provenance.note: Version read: Substitute Senate Bill (Comm Sub), HTML copy with marks. Sec. 1 (RCW 9.41.010) adds definitions of 'assault weapon' and 'detachable magazine'. Despite the title, this version has no large capacity magazine rules or new licensure; it extends pistol purchase, record, dealer and under-21 rules to assault weapons. Sec. 8 quote is the sentence as amended (adds an exception for assault weapons to out-of-state rifle/shotgun purchases).

Sec. 8 (RCW 9.41.124): Residents of a state other than Washington may purchase rifles and shotguns, except those firearms defined as assault weapons, in Washington: PROVIDED, That such residents conform to the applicable provisions of the federal Gun Control Act of 1968, Title IV, Pub.
